nodes.label: Wave Survival Reforged 2.0.0
nodes.rationale: Ships 1.6 and 1.7 from the same source so the 1.6 run keeps every update and the save carries over; Multiplayer is unsupported.

nodes.label: Wave type variety (pods, breachers, mechs, sappers, DLC horrors)
nodes.rationale: Waves are data-driven from Defs/WaveTypes.xml so players and modders can add their own, with Royalty/Anomaly content gated behind the DLC.

nodes.label: Pre-rolled next wave (telegraphed)
nodes.rationale: The wave is decided when it is scheduled and shown in the alert and HUD with faction and strength, so what is advertised is what actually arrives.

nodes.label: Casual / Standard / Brutal / Custom presets
nodes.rationale: A run keeps the preset it started with, so later settings changes cannot retroactively rebalance a run in progress.

nodes.label: Wave screen effect (1.7)
nodes.rationale: Screen-edge glow colour-codes wave class (red, violet special, amber boss) and is switchable for photosensitive players.

nodes.label: No-beacon fallback drop
nodes.rationale: After 3 days without an orbital trade beacon a half-size, weaponless drop lands near the colony so a beaconless run is not starved out entirely.

nodes.label: Phantom wave fix and wave fallback chain
nodes.rationale: 'Wave N has arrived' only fires on real spawn; an unrunnable wave degrades to raid, then manhunter pack, then waits a few hours keeping its number, so wave numbering is never silently skipped.

nodes.label: Whole-wave threat scaling
nodes.rationale: The threat scale now applies to the whole wave rather than only its growth, so wave 1 already differs between Peaceful and Losing is Fun.

nodes.label: Supply drop stockpile counting fix
nodes.rationale: Items still lying near the beacon count toward the cap so unhauled drops stop more of the same arriving.
